connect.title: Connect to Chrome first
connect.step1: In the Chrome where your accounts are signed in, paste this address into a new tab:
connect.copyFailed: Couldn't copy, type it by hand
connect.step2: Tick Allow remote debugging for this browser instance.
connect.step3: Press the button below. If Chrome asks for permission, choose Allow.
connect.connecting: Connecting. If Chrome asks for permission, allow it.
images.title: Images
images.hint: Up to 4 images. Drag and drop them here, and drag to change their order.
caption.title: Caption
targets.title: Where to share?
share.dryHint: "Try" prepares everything but doesn't press Share. The tabs stay open.
confirm.title: Publish this post?
confirm.body: The open account is checked first on each platform. If it doesn't match the one you entered, nothing is shared there.
account.label: {name} account
run.readyOk: Ready, not shared. The tab stayed open.
run.readySaveAccount: Ready, not shared. To share, save this account if it's the right one.
run.readyNoAccount: Ready, not shared. But the open account couldn't be read, so a real share would stop.
run.unverified: The button was pressed but the result couldn't be verified. Check the tab before sharing again.
run.loginNeeded: You're signed out. Sign in on the opened tab and it will continue by itself.
error.loginTimeout: the time to sign in ran out
error.noComposer: the post screen wasn't found. The site may have changed, or it may not be in English or Turkish
error.accountUnreadable: the open account couldn't be read, stopped for safety. Enlarge the window and try again
error.captionFailed: the caption couldn't be typed into the text box
error.connect: Couldn't connect to Chrome. Chrome must be open. Go to chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging, tick "Allow remote debugging for this browser instance", try again and allow the prompt that appears.
error.fileType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP can be added; the others were skipped.
error.tooManyPicked: Up to {max} images can be added; the extras were skipped.
error.tooManyImages: Up to {max} images can be added.
error.badImageType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP can be uploaded.
error.tooLarge: The images are too large. Each must be 30 MB or less.
error.missingAccount: First enter the account to share from: {names}. Press "Try" to see the account name.
error.saveAccounts: Account names couldn't be saved. The program may have closed.
error.unreachable: The server can't be reached. The program may have closed.
error.busy: A share is already in progress.
